system.longDesc: You can use arcane energies to protect yourself and others from harm.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Protection Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Protection Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Protection Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Protection Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Protection Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Protection Arcana spells for –1 SP.
